transcript.text: Hi Diane, thanks for calling the Massachusetts RMV. How can I help you today?
My license is expiring and I want to upgrade to REAL ID. What do I need to bring?

To upgrade to a REAL ID, you'll need to bring original or acceptable printed paper documents to an RMV service center or participating AAA branch. You'll need to verify your identity, lawful presence, Social Security number, and Massachusetts residency in person. Please note that photos on a phone screen are not accepted.
Diane Martin, date of birth June 9, 1969.
Your driver's license expires on December 18, 2026, and it is not currently a REAL ID. You have one active vehicle registration with plate J K 3 0 7 5, which expires on December 6, 2028.
